name: handfish-design
description: Expert guidance for building web applications with the Handfish Design System — 21 Web Components (including the industrial knob/LED/tempo controls, a config-driven menu bar, and the Seance collaboration set), the AboutDialog class, --hf-* design tokens, OKLCH color palette, light-DOM style injection, 20 named themes, an industrial typeface language, and bidi/RTL readiness. Teaches conventions, prevents common pitfalls, and guides component integration.
